cost_boundary: Main controller ContextVars and authenticated child summaries are separate. Known V45-controller/child call counts are aggregated; original V2 regression launches are separately inventoried from raw packets. Nested/overlapping wall intervals are not additive. Raw-only/failed artifacts are retained even where their inventory has an explicit obstruction; complete engineering/model lifecycle cost remains UNKNOWN.

known_attempt_totals.boundary: Known V45 main-controller plus authenticated child call counts; compiler durations are elapsed compiler-process intervals, not an additional end-to-end wall duration. Original V2 regression calls are separately visible in the raw invocation inventory. Other lifecycle costs remain UNKNOWN.

raw_native_audit.boundary: Every retained raw controller invocation is inventoried, including UNKNOWN/unbound negatives. Original packet/status reconstruction authenticates complete retained V2/V42/V43/V45 certificates and receipts. Positive counters count unique V45 execution paths only. Complete compiler/source sidecars remain archived for independent declaration-authority inspection.

retained_invocation_inventory.boundary: Every retained controller checked-report outside tracked fixture source; UNKNOWN/partial packets retained. No raw-only entry grants admission. Launches without a checked report remain in controller/compiler attempt ledgers.
